2025
Author: Kuldeep Mathur

Bench: Kuldeep Mathur [2025:RJ-JD:18156]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc Interim Bail Application No. 4277/2025 Premsingh S/o Vijaysingh, Aged About 43 Years, R/o Suawato Ka Guda, Teh. Mavli, Ps Dabok, Dist. Udaipur, Raj.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Lodged In Central Jail Udaipur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ojas Shakdwipeeya  Mr. Sanjay Bishnoi For Respondent(s) : Mr. Surendra Bishnoi, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR  ORDER 08/04/2025
The present interim bail application under Section 483 BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner on the ground that his father Vijay Singh has expired on 02.04.2025.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that as per the rituals, the presence of petitioner is essential in order to perform the last rites and rituals of his father.
It is therefore, prayed that the petitioner may be released on interim bail for a period of 30 days.
Learned Public Prosecutor has not disputed the factum of petitioner's father passing away.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, so also the fact that presence of petitioner is essential for performing the last rites on account of death of his father, this Court deems it just and proper to grant interim bail to the accused petitioner for a period seven (7) days.

Accordingly, the interim bail application filed under Section 483 BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Premsingh S/o Vijaysingh arrested in connection with F.I.R.

F.I.R.
Premsingh vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:18156)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: : RJ-JD:18156] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-4277/2025] No.160/2024, registered at Police Station Dabok,

for the offences under Sections 363, 366-A, 376(2) and 376(3) IPC, Section 5/6 of the POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(va) and 3(1) (w)(1) of the SC/ST Act, be released on interim bail for a period of seven days, provided he furnishes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.4,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (out of which one surety will be a close relative of the petitioner) each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his surrender on completion of seven days from the date of actual release.

Let this bail application be again listed on 21.04.2025, and on which date, learned Public Prosecutor shall be required to submit the compliance report of the order whether petitioner has surrendered or not.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 281-TarunGoyal/-
